text:
elena: quick heads-up — planning to roll shard-scheduler v2 tonight in the 02:30 UTC window. This includes a small schema tweak to orders.shard_key and a short backfill (est ~20m). We'll run dual-write for ~1h. Looking for a deploy owner and a smoke lead. ops runbook: https://redwood/ops/shard-scheduler-runbook :sparkles:
chad: i'll own deploy. can we reduce backfill batch size to avoid a long tail?
elena: yes — backfill config will use batch_size=500 and throttle=0.6. snippet:
```
BACKFILL_BATCH=500
THROTTLE=0.6
```
samir: i'll run smoke & canary. plan: canary at 02:35 UTC with 5% traffic, hold for 10m and validate reads/writes on a sample of keys across shards.
chad: rollback plan: revert schema flag + promote read-only replica snapshots. runbook steps 4-7 cover this. revert script staged at /ops/scripts/revert_shard_sched.sh
deploy-bot: deploy scheduled by chad at 02:30 UTC — CI checks green :white_check_mark:
elena: cc @ops-oncall — if we see db p99 latency > 250ms during backfill, abort and rollback.
ops-oncall: noted. i'll monitor p95/p99 and slow queries; setting alert thresholds now.
samir: smoke checklist:
- confirm canary metrics stable
- verify no duplicate orders in sample
- check tail latencies
- run quick selects from replicas
chad: i've reserved a 03:45 UTC slot as a rollback buffer if we need to re-run the backfill with a smaller batch.
elena: thanks. i'll post a "starting" ping 10m before 02:30.
chad: got it. +1
samir: ready. :thumbsup:
elena: last call — any objections? if none i'll lock the window.
chad: no objections.
ops-oncall: all clear from infra side.
elena: locking window. starting notice in 10m.
